Solution 1 is wrong. Its claimed root is about 2.873 + 1.698i. Substituting into the depressed form Q(y) = y⁴ − 121y² + 44y + 4205 (with x = y − 5) gives a real part of about 178, so it is not a root.

Solution 2 reaches 0 with no valid derivation. It has no justified steps and ends in a guess.

Solution 3 is wrong. Its claimed root is y = −0.153 + 13.297i, and substituting into Q(y) gives a real part of about 56,000, so it is not a root.

For reference, the first-quadrant root is about 2.917 + 1.889i. Exact factoring gives s² = (243 + √66793)/8 for the depressed form. Testing integer a, b with |a| and |b| up to about 10 finds no choice where (2r − a − bi)² has integer real and imaginary parts. So 0 is not supported, though this search is not exhaustive. None of the three solutions is correct.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
VERDICT 2: REJECT
VERDICT 3: REJECT
